Author: MathDad
Name: Senpan Admin Companion
Description: Serves as an alternative to many of the web-interface functions, allowing staff to operate various systems from within the game.
Punchline: Allows Senpan Tea House staff to use various app services right from the game.
Changelog: Adds a Gpose Booth page under Festival: work a booth's sign-ups in game - mark them done, a no-show or canceled, record them paid, undo a mistake, call the next person up, and put someone from the waitlist into a freed slot. Needs the Senpan server 5.7.0 or later.
